test: LIVE-4 sigma evaluation, stationary, AFTER the 2026-08-04 sigma changes
changes: blend.sigma_support_var: three variance terms added to Stage 7c
disagreement  = w * |D_tof - D_net|      (how far the blend moves the depth)
spread        = w * |D_tof - local_mean(D_tof)|  (is this zone the odd one out?)
cost_method: offline A/B on one logged frame, same engines, 25 iterations, per-stage timings: 82.10 ms with the terms vs 81.29 ms with the constants zeroed.
rescale_finding: Step 4 (re-fit the sigma SCALE) is not applicable. Sweeping a single multiplier: 0.37x reaches coverage 0.727 but pushes the mixed-return marker to 6.23 sigma; 2.5x covers everything at 1.000. The errors are heavy-tailed -- most points far inside, one far outside -- so no single scale serves both ends. Coverage is WORSE after the change (0.818 -> 0.909) precisely because the dangerous case is now covered.
caveats: n = 11. Three constants were tuned against these 11 points; overfitting risk is real.
The mixed-return marker improved 3.86 -> 2.30 sigma but still fails. Its neighbourhood is half-covered by the intruding bottle, so the zone is not a strong local outlier.
Rate was re-measured in the dark. 9.35 Hz, above the 8.3 Hz floor, but worth re-confirming lit.
Frame-to-frame variance (task 3) NOT implemented -- needs temporal state in the node.
